description: This PHP source file 'date_api.php' provides functions related to date and time management within the TestLink project. It includes functions for generating HTML options for date components (months, days, years), creating date selection widgets, validating timestamps, and converting locale-specific date formats to ISO format. The file appears to serve as a utility API for date-related operations in the application.

methods.name: create_month_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for a dropdown list of months, optionally pre-selecting a given month.

methods.name: create_numeric_month_option_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for months represented numerically, with optional pre-selection.

methods.name: create_day_option_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for days in a month, optionally pre-selecting a specific day.

methods.name: create_year_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for years from the current year down to 2000, with optional pre-selection.

methods.name: create_date_selection_set
methods.description: Creates a complex date selection widget that includes a date input, calendar icon, and optional time selectors. It supports configuration for mandatory fields, allowing blanks, and displaying on filters.

methods.name: create_range_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for a numeric range, marking the selected value.

methods.name: checkTimeStamp
methods.description: Validates the format and content of a timestamp string, supporting 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' formats.

methods.name: locateDateToISO
methods.description: Converts a locale-specific date string into ISO format (YYYYMMDD) based on the specified date format.
